title: ranunculus sardous subsp. trilobus
intro: Ranunculus sardous subsp. trilobus, commonly known as Sardian crowsfoot, is a plant species belonging to the buttercup family (Ranunculaceae). It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include its ability to treat digestive issues and skin conditions due to its health benefits of reducing inflammation and improving wound healing. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including alkaloids and phenolic compounds, which exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. However, more research is needed to fully understand the bioactive constituents of Ranunculus sardous subsp. trilobus.
